== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}

William Glasko was born ca. 1850, and died on May 18, 1870. He was the son of [[Glasko-3|Isaac Glasko]] and [[Billings-3866|Mary Billings]].  

He was a stationary engineer.

Glasko, William A., son of Isaac & Mary E., died May 18, 1870, age 20 yrs. 8 mos. 21 days.  He was buried in the Lovett Cemetery, Sprague, New  London County, Connecticut, United States. <ref>[https://www.halecollection.com/318-1-lovett-cemetery.htm Hale  Collection 318-1 Lovett Cemetery Records, Town of Sprague, New London County, Connecticut]</ref>


== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasko-3]] is assessed at 98% (proved). William’s held burial wording explicitly calls him son of Isaac and Mary E, and his 1860 household entry is with Isaac M. The uncommon surname, age and parental pairing identify this father with high confidence.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the 1870 Massachusetts death image and Lovett inscription.
